name: Context Menu
description: Floating singleton context menu that positions at click coordinates. Items can be labels with actions, separators, or disabled items. All existing menus are closed before a new one opens (static openMenus tracking). Menu closes on outside click (document click listener added after 0ms timeout to avoid immediate close). Fires optional onClose callback on removal.

interface.constructor: (items: ContextMenuItem[], x: number, y: number) — Closes all existing menus via static openMenus loop, clears array, creates .ctx-menu div positioned at (x,y), builds item children (.ctx-item normal, .ctx-item.ctx-disabled for disabled, .ctx-sep for separators), binds click handlers (item click fires action → remove()), appends to document.body, pushes to openMenus, adds document click listener (outsideClick) after 0ms setTimeout

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes document click listener (outsideClick), splices self from static openMenus array, removes .ctx-menu element from DOM, fires optional onClose callback

properties.name: onClose
properties.description: Optional callback invoked after menu removal — null by default, set by caller before remove()

events.name: onClose
events.description: Fired during remove() after DOM removal — allows callers to clean up state tied to menu lifetime

lifecycle.created_by: Right-click event handlers in CanvasArea, MonacoEditorPlugin, FileExplorerPlugin, MarkdownPlugin, GitPlugin — new ContextMenu(items, x, y)
lifecycle.destroyed_by: remove() called by: item click action, outside document click (outsideClick handler), or opening a new context menu (which calls remove() on all openMenus)
